> Prepare and verify a release

1. Confirm Conventional Commits and release rules.
2. Run PromptScript validation and project validation contract.
3. Verify version, tag, changelog, generated files, and artifacts.
4. Let Release Please own version and changelog changes.
5. Verify publishing workflow checks tag and artifact (`dist/index.html`).
6. Stop before publishing unless explicitly authorized.
